test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

He and his family members live in __prosperity__.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'.** i.e. **'Richness'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined word **"prosperity"** means the state of being successful and having a lot of money (समृद्धि).
